items.title: Diagonal Puzzle Tile DXF Pattern for Contemporary Screens
items.description: Interlocking puzzle-piece tiles line up in tight diagonal rows, giving a woven, jigsaw-like texture across the whole panel. The consistent diagonal flow suits contemporary screens, balcony infill, and facades wanting a busy, tactile pattern.
